# About this guide {.unnumbered}

Calculus becomes more useful when I can explain why a method works, rather than
just remember the steps. This living guide records those explanations as I learn.
It assumes some familiarity with differentiation and integration.

The first chapter starts with a question: **why does an integrating factor turn a
differential equation into something we can integrate?** It includes a worked
initial-value problem and exercises with separate solutions.

This is a growing guide, not a complete calculus course. Proposed later topics
include limits, the fundamental theorem of calculus and choosing integration
methods. Those topics are plans, not completed chapters.
